name: crash-resume
description: W7: W4's setup, then 10 turns; every third turn's cell is parked on a slow tool while every code-mode worker is killed, and resumes on a fresh worker with its 1 MB global. Three crashes stay under the pool's restart-storm bound (8 restarts a minute).

turns.user: Turn {turn}: load the corpus and keep it.

cell: const big = await tools.fixture_large({ key: "corpus", bytes: 1000000 });
const describe = (record, size) => record.title + " / " + size + " bytes kept";
let last = "none";
await control.finish({ loaded: big.bytes, length: big.text.length });

turns.user: Turn {turn}: check item {turn} against the corpus.

cell: const record = await tools.fixture_lookup({ key: "item-{turn}" });
const waited = await tools.fixture_slow({ key: "wait-{turn}", ms: 20 });
last = describe(record, big.text.length);
await control.finish({ turn: {turn}, last: last, waited: waited.waited_ms });

turns.user: Turn {turn}: check item {turn} while the workers crash.

cell: const record = await tools.fixture_lookup({ key: "item-{turn}" });
const waited = await tools.fixture_slow({ key: "crash-{turn}", ms: 20, kill_workers: true });
last = describe(record, big.text.length);
await control.finish({ turn: {turn}, last: last, waited: waited.waited_ms });
